title: Live-cell metabolic analysis of oligodendroglia isolated from postnatal mouse brain and spinal cord
protocol: Rapidly decapitate mouse.
Cut skull from brainstem to olfactory bulb.
Remove skull by pulling away to the sides.
Scoop out brain and place in petri dish with cold PBS.
Cut and peel back skin to access spinal column.
Dissect out spinal column by cutting through ribs and freeing entire length of the column.
Pinch caudal end of the cord with blunt-ended forceps with wide, serrated tips.
Squeeze the cord out progressively by moving forceps one over the other until the entire cord is removed.
Place the dissected spinal cord in a petri dish with cold PBS.
Chop tissues to a paste-like consistency using a razor blade.
Pool 3 brains or 3 spinal cords at a time and transfer tissues to empty petri dishes when all dissections are complete.
Add 1,950 μL preheated enzyme mix (50 μL Enzyme P + 1,900 μL Buffer X) to 3 pooled P10 spinal cords.
Double the volume of enzyme mix for 3 pooled brain samples.
Transfer enzyme-mixed tissues to 15 mL conical tubes.
Incubate samples for 15 min at 37°C.
Mix every 2–3 min by inverting tubes.
Add 30 μL Enzyme mix 2 (20 μL Buffer Y + 10 μL Enzyme A) to spinal cord samples.
Double the volume of enzyme mix 2 for brain samples.
Mix by inverting tubes.
Pipette up and down 10× with a 5 mL pipette.
Incubate for 10 min at 37°C.
Mix every 2–3 min by inverting tubes.
Pipette up and down 10× with a 1 mL tip.
Place tubes on ice and let tissues settle for 2 min.
Transfer supernatant (with cells) to fresh 15 mL conical tube.
Pass through pre-wet 70 μm filter while transferring.
Break up remaining tissue pellet by pipetting up and down 10× with a 200 μL tip.
Transfer (through filter) to conical tube with cells from step 2h.
Bring up to 10 mL with BSA buffer.
Count cells with Trypan blue exclusion.
Spin down cells at 400 × g for 5 min and aspirate supernatant to remove enzyme.
Add 80 μL of BSA buffer/ 5 × 10^6 cells.
Split samples into multiple tubes if more than 5 × 10^6 cells are present.
Add 10 μL mouse FcR Blocking Reagent to each sample/tube.
Mix well by flicking.
Incubate for 10 min at 4°C.
Add 10 μL of Anti-O4 microbeads to each tube.
Mix well by flicking.
Incubate for 15 min at 4°C.
Add 1 mL of BSA buffer to each tube.
Centrifuge at 400 × g for 5 minutes at 4°C.
Aspirate supernatant completely.
Resuspend cells in 1 mL BSA buffer.
Separate plungers from MS columns.
Place columns in the magnetic field of OctoMACS Separator.
Verify that column is facing the correct way.
Rinse each column with 500 μL BSA buffer.
Add a pre-wet 30 μm filter to each column.
Apply cell suspension onto column filter.
Discard flow-through containing unlabeled cells.
Wash column three times with 500 μL BSA buffer.
Discard unlabeled cells that pass through during washing steps.
Remove each column from separator and place on collection tube.
Pipette 1 mL BSA buffer into the column.
Flush out O4+ enriched cells by firmly pushing plunger into the column.
Keep cells on ice.
Count cells with trypan blue exclusion.
Proceed to downstream analyses.
Plate O4+ oligodendroglia for live cell metabolic measurements.
Perform the Seahorse Mitochondrial Stress Test on plated cells.
Measure oxygen consumption rate (OCR) during the assay.
Add modulators of respiration through injection ports.
Measure extracellular acidification rate (ECAR) during the assay.
Remove water from wells in the cartridge and add pre-warmed calibrant 45-60 min before running the assay.
Prepare Seahorse plate by removing PDL from the plate.
Wash the plate once with sterile water.
Dry the plate completely after washing.
Plate cells into the prepared Seahorse plate.
Centrifuge isolated O4+ cells at 400 × g for 5 min at 4°C.
Resuspend centrifuged cells in 540 μL pre-warmed assay media to a concentration of 40,000 cells/180 μL.
Add 180 μL of cell suspension (containing 40,000 cells) to wells B-G.
Centrifuge the plate for 1 min at 400 × g to ensure quick settling of cells in the wells.
Place the cell plate in a non-CO2 incubator set at 37°C while preparing stock compounds.
Add 252 μL assay medium to prepare a 50 μM oligomycin solution.
Add 288 μL assay medium to prepare a 50 μM FCCP solution.
Add 216 μL assay medium to make 25 μM rotenone and antimycin A solution.
Pipette each compound up and down 20 times to solubilize.
Load Sensor Cartridge with compounds by following Table 1.
Dispense oligomycin into Port A, FCCP into Port B, rotenone/antimycin A into Port C, and 20 μL of assay medium or PBS into Port D.
Orient the pipette tips at a slight angle when dispensing compounds into ports and dispense towards the side wall or corner of the port without pushing tips completely into the port holes.
Select XF Cell Mito Stress Test on the Templates window of the Seahorse XF Mini Analyzer.
Add information about each experimental group on the Plate map tab.
Start equilibration of Seahorse XF Mini Analyzer by touching “Start Run”.
Load the cartridge (hydrated and loaded with compounds) onto the tray when prompted.
Ensure the cartridge fits properly, the lid is removed from the cartridge, and the direction of the cartridge matches the image on the screen.
Run the Seahorse XF Cell Mito Stress Test.
Touch “Continue” when you are ready to load your plate.
Remove the utility plate and load the cell plate.
Ensure the lid is removed from the cell plate before loading onto the Analyzer tray.
Run the assay for approximately 1.5 hours.
Eject the sensor cartridge once the assay is complete.
Retrieve the cell plate from the instrument.
Normalize results using the cell plate.
Gently remove media without disturbing cells.
Add 50 μL of RIPA lysis buffer with Halt protease/phosphatase inhibitor cocktail into each well.
Pipette up and down 5 times to lyse and mix.
Measure total protein per well using standard measurement protocols.
Normalize results as described in the protocol.
Pause point: Protein measurement can be performed immediately or the plate stored at -80°C for later analysis.
